title: These Are OK If Your Cat Takes to Them
text: These Are OK If Your Cat Takes to Them. I bought two of these. Some of my cats like them OK, but generally most of them prefer the couch, fleeces, and/or blankets. Still they were fine until we had a flea infestation. Then, because I couldn't wash them with borax, I had to dispose of them.

The ultra-soft polyester fibers act as an insulator, to absorb and hold the heat, keeping your kitty warm and cuddly year-round. Handcrafted in the USA. 100% Recyclable Materials. 100% Non-Allergenic. 100% Non-Toxic.
